_readme: The single source of truth for what the tazrim container may reach through Squid (ENG-131). docker/squid/banks.txt is GENERATED from this file: run `node scripts/egress-allowlist.mjs` after editing. A test (scripts/__tests__/egress-allowlist.test.ts) fails when israeli-bank-scrapers has a company missing here, or banks.txt is stale. 'domains' = the provider's own hosts, from the scraper source (israeli-bank-scrapers 6.13.0, lib/scrapers/*.js). 'thirdParty' = hosts the provider's pages load that login needs, from scripts/egress-survey.mjs. NOTE (2026-11-21): every thirdParty list is still EMPTY: the survey could not be run yet (no IPv4 route on the machine it was written on). Run it (README: upgrading the scraper), review each third-party host (needed for login vs tracking), and add the needed ones here with a 'why'. Never add a broad shared host (cloud storage, code hosting, paste or webhook sites): a test rejects the known ones.
